description: This file defines an abstract Java class ByteBuffer that provides an interface and partial implementation for a byte buffer supporting get and put operations, including handling of EOF and buffer overflow exceptions, and methods for reading/writing integers and shorts in little-endian format.

classes.name: ByteBuffer
classes.description: An abstract class providing a framework for byte buffer operations with support for getting and putting bytes, integers, and shorts, including exception handling for EOF and buffer overflow scenarios.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the buffer is empty based on its length.

methods.name: isFull
methods.description: Checks if the buffer is full based on its length and size.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Abstract method to get the total capacity of the buffer.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Abstract method to get the amount of data currently stored in the buffer.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the next byte from the buffer.

methods.name: get(byte[])
methods.description: Reads bytes into the provided array from the buffer.

methods.name: get(byte[], int, int)
methods.description: Reads a specified number of bytes into the array starting at a given offset.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Abstract method to put a byte into the buffer.

methods.name: put(byte[])
methods.description: Puts bytes from the provided array into the buffer.

methods.name: put(byte[], int, int)
methods.description: Puts a specified number of bytes from the array into the buffer starting at an offset.

methods.name: getInt
methods.description: Reads a 32-bit little-endian integer from the buffer.

methods.name: getShort
methods.description: Reads a 16-bit little-endian short from the buffer.

methods.name: putInt
methods.description: Writes a 32-bit little-endian integer into the buffer.
